name: Florida Campground
evidence: Esri 0.21 m/px: Florida River riparian strip ~20 m wide incl. gravel, water ~10-20 m, under the ~30 m size rule; pads on spurs off west road ~8-20 m from strip. rec.gov 232214: all 20 sites FCFS, no coords, photos or proximity tags. FS: 'some well-shaded sites near the river'. Water surface partly hidden by willow.

name: Estes Park Campground at Mary's Lake
evidence: Esri z17 + USGS 3DEP: pool 2450.7 m; Marys Lake Rd embankment 2453-2455 m between; south camp area 2449 m, RV rows 2447-2442 m, upper loops ~2430s-2440s, all below pool, so below-dam rule gives no lake value. Campendium site photos show mountains, no lake. Operator pages (evrpd.com) refused, unread.

name: Golden Horn Designated Camping Area
evidence: Esri 0.21 m/px: S Fork Mineral Creek (NHD) channel ~8-15 m; open dirt/grass flat, no treeline; RVs ~38-50 m from channel over open unused ground inside rock/log barrier, one car ~16-20 m. Closer spots blocked per 2025-08 Campendium review; FS 100-ft rule. Remaining pads still within open-apron bound.

name: Goose Creek Campground
evidence: Lower loop ~200 m SE of pin (prior look saw upper loops only). Esri 39.1700,-105.3585 + 3DEP hillshade: incised channel (NHD Goose Creek) at the meadow's south edge, tables and a bare pad ~15-25 m away over open grass. Water itself never seen, under shrubs; FS 'runs through the campground' is prose; rig fit on that pad unconfirmed. Not earned, held down.

name: Haviland Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233254 per-site 'Lakefront': Loop A 003-006 (FCFS, no coords, 40 ft), 039-045 (reservable, 28-40 ft). Site 045 pin ~37 m from shore, scattered pines, 5 m drop (3DEP), rec.gov photo shows lake through trees: tag not contradicted there. 039-044 ~45-70 m in trees are lakeview distance. Earned on 045 and the tag.

name: Hidden Lakes Campground
evidence: Esri ~0.1 m/px: small loop at lake's NW corner; open bare slash ground ~20-35 m from loop road to sandy shore, 6 m drop (3DEP), log barrier along road's outer edge. Pads not individually legible, so own loop road may lie between. rec.gov 10361305: 9 sites, no coords, photos or tags; FS 'adjacent to' lake is prose. Open sightline holds; on-water unproven, default down.

name: Hayden Creek Campground
evidence: Esri + 3DEP hillshade: incised channel ~44-66 m north of road/loop through continuous forest; none seen by the loop; canopy heavy, offset NHD lines unreliable. Listing photos show no water. FS 'on the banks of Hayden Creek' is prose; no per-site map, so nothing counting. Hipcamp/The Dyrt unread.

name: Hahns Peak Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 231863 Lake loop coords on Esri + NHD: sites 007 (60 ft), 008 (25 ft) ~40-45 m from shore over open grass, scattered trees, no road between, ~4 m drop (3DEP); south-row pads ~55 m. Open unused apron within bound. No rec.gov proximity tags. Sites on upstream peninsula, not below dam. Site photos: open grass, lake not obvious in frame.
